steps.en: Officer sees the list of suspension and revival codes
steps.id: Officer melihat daftar kode suspension dan revival

steps.en: Officer adds a new temporary suspension code with reason and period
steps.id: Officer menambah kode temporary suspension baru dengan alasan dan periode

steps.en: Officer adds a new revival code with its reason
steps.id: Officer menambah kode revival baru dengan alasannya

steps.en: Officer edits a code description, period or active status
steps.id: Officer mengubah deskripsi, periode, atau status aktif sebuah kode

steps.en: A new or inactive code is accepted or refused when a suspension is applied
steps.id: Kode baru atau tidak aktif diterima atau ditolak saat suspension diterapkan

steps.en: A revival code is checked against the configured list when a notice is revived
steps.id: Kode revival dicek terhadap daftar terkonfigurasi saat notice di-revive
steps.why_en: Revivals coming from the PLUS system only accept two fixed codes, whatever is configured.
steps.why_id: Revival dari sistem PLUS hanya menerima dua kode tetap, apa pun konfigurasinya.

steps.en: The configured period sets when a temporary suspension is revived
steps.id: Periode yang dikonfigurasi menentukan kapan temporary suspension di-revive
